vb_textbox.text: Hello! I have been tasked to write you advice for this experiment, so, as I have completed the game with a score of around 1080, I will give you tips on what you should be doing:1. The first thing you should do is find the pair of coloured aliens, there are only 2 pairs and they will stay the same colour throughout the entire experiment, so that means if there is a Green Alien on one side and a Purple Alien on the other side, that means they are a pair and they will always come as one, you will not have a Green Alien and a Red Alien because they are not the pair you are given with.2. Check sides every time, if you see a Purple Alien on the left side, they won't be there every time, so you need to check both sides in very short notice.3. Check to see how often you are getting higher mushrooms, if you are consistently getting low mushroom counts, (more than 3 times in a row from the same alien), consider trying the other colour Alien to see if they can get you any higher.4. If suddenly you are not getting as many mushrooms you would previously, then the switcheroo has happened! This means that the opposite colour of the pair is likely now giving you more mushrooms then the one you were getting from, however this is not always the case and maybe both Aliens do not give you many mushrooms.5. Finally, you should stay as consistent as possible as quick as possible, if you find something that works, keep going for it - until it doesn't work anymore. p.s have fun!!
